preconditions.description: The number of cities, n, is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads, m, is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of queries, q, is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The type value and crowd value of each road are between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The starting city, destination city, and minimum number of unique buildings for each query are between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road starts and ends in the same city.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 if there is no path with at least k_i different types of buildings
postconditions.description: If no path exists that satisfies the condition, the output should be -1.

postconditions.expression: Output is the minimum crowd value for a path with at least k_i different types of buildings
postconditions.description: If a path exists, the output should be the minimum crowd value for that path.

invariants.description: The input values for cities, roads, queries, building types, and crowd values are all integers.
Paths can include repeated cities and roads, allowing for cycles.
